version_policy: Verify and lock the latest stable compatible PHP, Laravel, Octane and server releases when implemented.

comparison.api_and_behavior: Identical existing shared HTTP contract and database schema
comparison.fixture: Canonical 50000 users and 500000 posts with verified restore before and after each trial
comparison.user_journey: Real login, following feed, likes, comments and posts; random 3–10-second waits
comparison.capacity_policy: 90% operation and authentication targets; final failure retest, third valid run only on disagreement; majority of three

verification_required: Choose one supported Octane server and document worker topology; preserve aggregate database connection cap20
Shared HTTP contracts and cross-language authentication interoperability
Request isolation, transaction rollback and database connection recovery for long-lived workers
Verified database TLS and wrong-hostname rejection
Image/dependency locks, actual process limits, clean VM baseline gates and generator calibration
execution_policy: Future comparison only. Not part of the active AWS queue. Use separate verified configuration and artifacts; do not modify historical results or the existing PHP runtime lock.
